verdict.rationale: Increase documents API-initiated ACH, wire, RTP and check transfers. It also offers optional human approval holds and real-time card authorization webhooks. However, the evidence never shows scoped credentials, amount caps, counterparty allowlists, or a vendor-named agent use case. Approval holds and real-time decisions are adjacent controls and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit toward this policy-bounded agent access story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
